comment: Current claude's queued-prompt format, branch-send variant: if a dispatched send ever lands in a just-busy pane, claude enqueues it (uuid-less queue-operation line) and replays it as a plain user line once the turn frees. The replay equals the outstanding branch send's text, so ordinary send correlation attributes the prompt AND its reply to the child thread — nothing is misattributed to main. New-format analogue of the legacy queued_command_branch case.
